## The question

[amsthm environment and colorbox](https://tex.stackexchange.com/questions/15267/amsthm-environment-and-colorbox), asked by [pluton](https://tex.stackexchange.com/users/371/pluton) on TeX Stack Exchange (2011-04-07; [CC BY-SA 2.5](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/2.5/)):

> I'd like to customize the `amsthm` command a little bit but I cannot find the relevant lines in the (undocumented?) .sty.
>
> 1. How can I put a colorbox on the *name* of the environment
>
>         \newtheoremstyle{Coloredtheo}%
>         {3pt}    %Space above
>         {3pt}    %Space below
>         {}       %Body font
>         {}       %Indent amount
>         {\bf \colorbox{blue}}    %Theorem head font
>         {}       %Punctuation after theorem head
>         {0.25em} %Space after theorem head
>         {}       %Theorem head spec
>
>  where the blue box should be of the size of the theorem head.
>
> 2. how I can remove the brackets of the optional parameter
>
>  `\begin{theorem}[Schwarz inequality]...` should not be (Schwarz inequality) but Schwarz inequality.
:::

> 1 - How can I put a colorbox under the
> name of the environment ... where the
> blue box should be of the size of the
> theorem head.

Take a look at the [`thmtools`](http://ctan.org/pkg/thmtools) package.  It gives a nice key-val interface to declaring all kinds of beautiful theorem-like environments.
